\footnotesize All budgets are averaged within a base circuit, then circuits receive equal weight. The primary objective is l = log10(MSE + $10^{-6}$); $\Delta\ell$ = l(policy) - l(SBS-B), paired percentile bootstrap over base circuits (1000 resamples). A difference $\Delta\ell$ changes the geometric mean of (MSE + $10^{-6}$) by the factor $10^{\Delta\ell}$; it is not a percentage change of the MSE. Mean MSE: arithmetic, circuit-weighted. Severe (risk $>$ 10 x RAW's risk): declared severe degradation (share of rows); q95: 95 \% quantile of the chosen risk. D18 = deployable features of 1.8.0; D = the deployable features of 1.7.0 (without the 1.8.0 noise-composition features), kept as frozen comparators; +S = with simulator-only features. Out-of-fold predictions (folds grouped by base circuit); the frozen configuration was chosen on these numbers, so they are not confirmatory.
